story.title: Tom Tiffany Suffers Minor Injuries After Emergency Plane Landing in Lake
story.summary: Wisconsin Congressman Tom Tiffany sustained minor injuries after his plane made an emergency landing in a lake late Saturday. Tiffany, who is also a candidate for governor, was returning from a Republican fundraising dinner when the aircraft lost power. He reportedly had to swim to safety following the incident.

explore_lenses.label: What is known about the landing and rescue?
explore_lenses.title: A water landing near Wausau airport
explore_lenses.summary: The available accounts place the emergency landing near Wausau Downtown Airport after a loss of power, with both occupants exiting the aircraft before it submerged. The basic sequence is reported, but the underlying mechanical cause is not.

claims.text: Tiffany said the single-engine, four-seat Bonanza lost power while approaching Wausau Downtown Airport after the La Crosse County Lincoln Day Dinner; the pilot then landed in Lake Wausau.

According to Tiffany's account, he and the pilot called 911, exited as the aircraft began to submerge, swam to shallow water, and were reached by responders by boat; both were treated at a hospital for minor injuries.
Tiffany publicly thanked the pilot, Wausau Fire Department and other first responders, describing their response as getting both occupants safely off the water.

explore_lenses.label: Will investigators determine why power was lost?
explore_lenses.title: Cause depends on aviation review
explore_lenses.summary: A loss-of-power water landing may lead to federal reporting and review, but an emergency landing alone does not establish probable cause. Whether the event meets the threshold for a formal NTSB investigation can depend on the injury severity and damage assessment.

claims.text: Federal rules require an aircraft operator to immediately notify the NTSB of an aviation accident or specified serious incidents; an accident includes a serious injury or substantial aircraft damage.
The NTSB says it evaluates an initial report to decide whether to investigate; if it does, its process includes fact gathering, analysis and a probable-cause determination.

The NTSB cautions that, absent a death or serious injury, it can take days to determine whether an aircraft sustained the substantial damage that triggers an investigation, and preliminary information should not be used to infer probable cause.

explore_lenses.label: Does the incident change Tiffany's campaign schedule?
explore_lenses.title: Future events remain posted
explore_lenses.summary: Tiffany is running for Wisconsin governor, and his campaign website continued to list public appearances later in the week. Those listings show planned events, not confirmation that he will attend after the hospitalization.

claims.text: Tiffany is a Republican candidate for Wisconsin governor; AP reported that he has President Donald Trump's endorsement.
Tiffany's campaign site listed September 17 Tavern Talk events in Theresa and Fond du Lac, a September 18 energy-policy town hall in Baraboo, and September 22 events in Highland and Baraboo.

The campaign's public statement emphasized that Tiffany and the pilot had only minor injuries and expressed gratitude for their care; it did not announce cancellations or provide a return-to-campaign timetable.

story_report.summary: U.S. Rep. Tom Tiffany, a Republican candidate for Wisconsin governor, sustained minor injuries late Saturday after a small plane lost power and made an emergency landing in Lake Wausau. Tiffany was returning from a Republican fundraising dinner and had to swim to safety after leaving the aircraft. He and the pilot were treated at a hospital for minor injuries, according to Tiffany’s account of the incident.

sections.heading: Tiffany Describes Lake Wausau Escape
sections.body: Tiffany said the single-engine, four-seat Bonanza lost power while approaching Wausau Downtown Airport after the La Crosse County Lincoln Day Dinner. According to his account, he and the pilot called 911, exited as the plane began to submerge and swam to shallow water, where responders reached them by boat. Tiffany publicly thanked the pilot, the Wausau Fire Department and other first responders.

sections.heading: Federal Investigation Status Remains Unclear
sections.body: Federal rules require aircraft operators to immediately notify the National Transportation Safety Board of an aviation accident or certain serious incidents. The agency evaluates initial reports to determine whether to investigate, and an investigation can include fact gathering, analysis and a probable-cause determination. The NTSB cautions that preliminary information should not be used to infer probable cause, particularly while damage assessments remain incomplete.

sections.heading: Tiffany Campaign Events Remain Posted
sections.body: Tiffany’s campaign calendar continued to list events beginning Sept. 17, including Tavern Talk stops in Theresa and Fond du Lac, an energy-policy town hall in Baraboo on Sept. 18, and Sept. 22 events in Highland and Baraboo. The campaign statement stressed that Tiffany and the pilot had minor injuries and expressed gratitude for their care, but did not announce cancellations or a timetable for his return to campaigning.

unresolved.text: Public reporting had not established why the aircraft lost power, including whether a mechanical, operational or weather-related factor was involved.
No consulted official source confirmed that the NTSB had opened a case or issued an official finding on the power loss as of Sept. 13.
The posted campaign calendar does not establish whether Tiffany will attend the listed events, and no revised schedule had been announced.

related_stories.title: Swedes Vote in Pivotal Election That May Bring Far-Right Party into Government
related_stories.summary: Voting is underway in Sweden's general election, which could see the far-right Sweden Democrats enter government for the first time. The election follows a closely contested campaign marked by intense political polarization, with the ruling right-wing bloc and the center-left opposition in a tight race. Key issues influencing voters include immigration and crime, reflecting a significant shift in Sweden's political landscape.

related_stories.title: Iran Reports Casualty in US Attack on Commercial Ship in Hormuz
related_stories.summary: Iranian authorities have reported that one crew member was killed when an Iranian commercial ship was struck near Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz. The Qeshm governor attributed the attack to a 'terrorist enemy,' though the exact nature of the projectile remains unidentified. This incident marks a continuation of tensions between the US and Iran in the region.
